passages.agriculture: The development of agr________ allowed people to grow crops and raise animals for food.
passages.artifact: The excavated art_____ was an object made by people, providing evidence of past human activity.
passages.ceramics: The museum displays cer_____, including fired-clay bowls and decorated tiles.
passages.pastoralism: The community practiced pas________, relying mainly on herds of livestock for its livelihood.
passages.pottery: Fragments of clay vessels fired in a kiln are examples of ancient pot____.
passages.prehistory: The period before written records is known as pre_______.
passages.radiocarbon-dating: The archaeologist used radiocarbon dat___ to estimate the age of ancient organic remains.
passages.trade-route: Merchants carried goods between cities along a major trade ro___.

questions.prompt: Archaeology: complete agr________. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：iculture → agriculture。学習語：agriculture。agricultureは「農業」。作物の栽培と家畜の飼育を指します。

questions.prompt: Archaeology: complete art_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ifact → artifact。学習語：artifact。artifactは「人工物・遺物」。人間が作った物で、過去の活動を知る証拠になります。

questions.prompt: Archaeology: complete cer_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：amics → ceramics。学習語：ceramics。ceramicsは「陶磁器」。粘土などを焼いて作る器やタイルを例にしています。

questions.prompt: Archaeology: complete pas________. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：toralism → pastoralism。学習語：pastoralism。pastoralismは「牧畜」。家畜の群れを飼育することを主な生業にしています。

questions.prompt: Archaeology: complete pot____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：tery → pottery。学習語：pottery。potteryは「陶器」。窯で焼いた粘土製の容器が根拠です。

questions.prompt: Archaeology: complete pre_______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：history → prehistory。学習語：prehistory。prehistoryは「先史時代」。文字による記録が残る以前の時代です。

questions.prompt: Archaeology: complete dat___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ing → dating。学習語：radiocarbon dating。radiocarbon datingは「放射性炭素年代測定」。有機物に残る炭素14を利用して年代を推定します。

questions.prompt: Archaeology: complete ro___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ute → route。学習語：trade route。trade routeは「交易路」。商品を運ぶために商人が利用する経路です。
